home.title: Formula 1 in numbers
home.lede: More than 1,100 Grands Prix with results, lap charts, tyre strategies and telemetry. The data is cross-checked across four sources and against official FIA documents.
home.mapTitle: The Grand Prix circus around the world
home.mapLede: Grands Prix held in each country between {from} and {to}; circle size is proportional to the number of races.
home.mapTableCaption: Circuits by number of Grands Prix
home.mapLedeCircuit: Grands Prix held at each circuit between {from} and {to}; circle size is proportional to the number of races.
home.mapTableCaptionCountry: Countries by number of Grands Prix

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.lede: Every World Championship season with its champions. The constructors' title has been awarded since 1958.
seasons.noConstructors: There was no constructors' championship yet in {season}.
seasons.progressionLede: Cumulative points race by race for the top ten.
seasons.progressionSummary: {leader} finished on {points} points; {second} was runner-up with {secondPoints}.
seasons.progressionSummaryInProgress: {leader} leads with {points} points; {second} is second with {secondPoints}.

race.upcomingRace: This race hasn't taken place yet.
race.noLaps: There is no lap-by-lap data for this race.
race.lapChartLede: Each line is a driver (or a car, if a driver drove two); hover or focus a line to highlight it.
race.lapChartSummary: {winner} won from {grid} on the grid and led {ledLaps} of {laps} laps.
race.tyresLede: Each bar is a stint between stops; colour and letter show the compound.
race.tyresSummary: The winner, {winner}, made {stops} stops. The most common strategy was {commonStops} stops.
race.noTyres: There is no tyre data for this race.
race.paceLede: Distribution of each driver's lap times. Lap 1, in and out laps, and laps under Safety Car, VSC or red flag are excluded.
race.pitstopsLede: Stops recorded by F1DB, consistent with the official FIA pit stop summaries.
race.noPitstops: There is no pit stop data for this race (F1DB records them from 1994).
race.passesLede: Pit lane entries that are not stops: penalties, passes under Safety Car, retirements or red flags.
race.telemetryLede: Each driver's fastest qualifying lap, sampled every 10 metres.
race.telemetrySummary: {a} set {timeA} and {b} {timeB}. Top speed: {topA} km/h versus {topB} km/h.
race.lapTimesLede: Lap time for each selected driver. Use the bar below the chart to narrow the laps.
race.lapTimesSummary: {fastest} set the fastest lap ({time}) on lap {lap}.
race.qualiGapTitle: Gap to the best qualifying time
race.qualiGapLede: Percentage gap between each driver's best time and the best time of the whole session (Q1, Q2 or Q3). For teams, the average of their drivers.
race.matrixLede: Each driver's compound on every lap. Outlined laps are pit-entry laps.
race.pitAvgTitle: Average pit stop time by constructor
race.pitAvgLede: Each team's average stop, excluding stops longer than a minute (red flags, problems or retirements), as in the thesis.
race.pitAvgSummary: {fastest} was quickest in the pits ({time} s on average); {slowest} was slowest ({slowTime} s).

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.lede: The 900 drivers who have taken part in the World Championship.
drivers.teammatesLede: Share of races and qualifying sessions finished ahead of the team-mate.
drivers.shareSummary: Finished ahead of team-mates in {pct} of {what}.

constructors.title: Constructors
constructors.lede: Every team that has taken part in the World Championship.

records.title: Records
records.lede: All-time rankings for drivers and constructors. Totals match F1DB's official figures.
records.titlesSummary: {name} won the most titles between {from} and {to}: {count}.
records.noTitles: Nobody won a title in this period.

quality.title: Data quality
quality.lede: Every value is cross-checked against at least one other source where possible. These checks run every week; if any falls below its threshold, the data is not published.
quality.summary: {pass} checks meet their threshold and {fail} fall below it.
sources: F1DB: results, qualifying, pit stops and championships since 1950.
formula1db.com: historical lap times (main source for laps).
FastF1: tyres, track status and telemetry since 2018, plus the latest races.
When sources disagree, official FIA documents decide or, failing that, Stats F1.
quality.infoLede: Tracking figures without a threshold: how many laps come from each source, how many are confirmed by another source, etc.
